items.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
items.summary_1line: Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemi...
items.editor_note: API로만 접근 가능한 모델을 위한 블랙박스 방식으로 스레드를 연다. 이 방식은 불확실성을 모호성과 지식 부족으로 나눈다.

items.title: Fast Bayesian Methods for Uncertainty Quantification in Sparse AI Evaluation
items.summary_1line: Estimating how an AI system will perform on a new benchmark need not require another large model. We use public evaluation counts to choose a weak Beta prior, then update it exactly from at most 31 revealed outcomes....
items.editor_note: 불확실성을 평가 자체에 적용한다. 공개된 집계 수치로 Beta 사전분포를 만들고, 최대 31개의 결과로 이를 갱신한다.

items.title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
items.summary_1line: Introduces a fixed-ranking benchmark that tests eight uncertainty quantification signals as monitors of LLM-based recommendation rankings across four datasets and two LLM backbones, reporting that method rankings shift between backbones.
items.editor_note: 백본 간 비교를 처음으로 수행한 검증이다. 4개 데이터셋에서 8개 신호를 평가했으며, 방법별 순위는 백본에 따라 달라진다.

editorial.tldr: On Nov 13 an arXiv paper proposed ensemble-of-ensembles uncertainty estimates for black-box LLMs that split prompt ambiguity from knowledge gaps. A Nov 18 paper moved the question to evaluation, estimating benchmark performance from at most 31 revealed outcomes with a Beta prior.
editorial.whats_new: A Nov 24 benchmark tested eight uncertainty signals as monitors of LLM recommender rankings on four datasets and found the method ranking changes when the LLM backbone changes.
editorial.why_it_matters: A confidence signal tuned on one model may not carry over when you swap the backbone, so uncertainty-based routing, abstention, and monitoring need per-model validation.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you gate, route, or abstain on an uncertainty score, re-check its calibration on your eval set every time you change the underlying model.

beats.headline: Black-box ensembles separate ambiguity from knowledge gaps
beats.summary: Brings Bayesian-style aleatoric/epistemic splits to API-only LLMs.

beats.headline: Bayesian estimates from 31 outcomes replace large eval runs
beats.summary: Applies uncertainty to the eval itself: how sure a small benchmark sample can make you.

beats.headline: Uncertainty method rankings shift between LLM backbones
beats.summary: A fixed-ranking recommender benchmark shows no single signal wins across models.

open_questions: Does the backbone-dependent ranking of uncertainty signals also appear outside recommendation tasks?
Does the ensemble-of-ensembles method stay reliable when evaluated across multiple model backbones?
Can 31-outcome Bayesian estimates predict agent or tool-use benchmark scores, not only static benchmarks?
